_meta.scope: Per model and task, the model's answers to the core questions that its predicted score is based on (from its core run, or the core questions within its full run). Each epoch is one answer. Descriptive metadata only: not used for scores or indices.

tags.provider_block_passed: Scored as correct, but at least one model call was blocked by the provider (content filter or block message), e.g. a refusal that the benchmark counts as right.
tags.sample_error: The sample ended with an error, so the model never finished.
tags.sample_limit: The sample hit an Inspect limit (time, tokens, messages, ...).
tags.provider_block: At least one model call was blocked by the provider (content filter or block message).
tags.looping: The model repeated itself: the end of its output compresses to under 15% of its size.
tags.max_tokens: At least one model call was cut off at the max_tokens limit.
tags.context_length: At least one model call ran out of context window.
tags.stopped_early: At least one model call stopped for an unusual reason (not stop, max_tokens, content_filter, model_length or tool_calls) without hitting the token limit.
tags.empty_output: The model returned no visible text (or there were no model calls).
tags.no_final_answer: The model answered, but the scorer found no final answer in it.
tags.wrong: The model gave an answer and it was scored as wrong.
tags.unscored: No usable score for the configured scorer.

outcomes.scope: outcomes: share of the answers in each group (sums to 1 up to rounding). model_outcomes: per model, the mean of its per-task shares, each task weighted equally. task_outcomes: per task, the mean of the per-model shares, each model weighted equally.
